notes: ProOS master integration catalog. Protech-owned source of truth for which HA integrations installers may use and how they're supported. Synced down to every ProCore. Edit here, commit, and each site picks it up on next sync. Tiers: 'certified' (Protech add-on with awareness/monitoring layer), 'native' (stock HA integration, usable but NOT maintained by Protech), 'hidden' (not shown to installers). v2 (3 Aug 2026): every domain running on the bench box is now classified — platform plumbing is 'hidden' with a ships-standard note so Pro can tell shipped-standard from foreign.

apple_tv.label: Apple TV
apple_tv.notes: ProOS build. Two-signal watcher (device ping + integration health) distinguishes asleep vs offline vs wedged.

samsungtv_smart.label: Samsung TV
samsungtv_smart.notes: ProOS build. Full power/source/AVR control with TV-state awareness.

homekit.label: Apple Home Bridge
homekit.notes: ProOS-configured HomeKit bridge (opt-in switchboard, full-restart apply).

unifi.label: UniFi Network
unifi.notes: ProOS-driven: network awareness, traffic witnesses for room verdicts, PoE control, device curation. Added v2 — was running uncatalogued.

music_assistant.notes: Music Assistant under ProOS commissioning — Core owns setup, providers and admin. Optional per site (music_assistant option). Added v2.
